description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike Women's Cotton Windbreaker Hoodie - Navy
description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Tech Fleece WindRunner Women's Hoodie combines the classic WindRunner design with premium Nike Tech Fleece fabric for a lightweight, warm and comfortable garment. Its construction with Woven panels and specific finishes for women provides a modern look perfect for everyday life or to show your passion for Barça.
key_benefits: Nike Tech Fleece fabric: Light, warm and very soft in contact with the skin.
Adjustable Hoodie: Greater protection against wind and low temperatures.
Woven panels: They reinforce the WindRunner design and provide a technical finish.
Zippered pockets: Security for storing small items.
Official FC Barcelona crest: Premium finish with the club's colors.
